shorts.title: What you will learn: Nested loops and patterns
shorts.hook: A loop inside a loop draws pictures.
shorts.script: A loop inside a loop draws pictures. Today we put a loop inside a loop. With it, you can print triangles, grids and tables. A nested loop is a loop inside another loop. For each round of the outer loop, the inner loop runs from start to finish. We use the outer loop for rows, and the inner loop for columns. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Nested loops and patterns.

shorts.title: Nested loops and patterns in one minute
shorts.hook: A nested loop is a loop inside another loop.
shorts.script: A nested loop is a loop inside another loop. For each round of the outer loop, the inner loop runs from start to finish. We use the outer loop for rows, and the inner loop for columns. Think of a clock. The minute hand goes all the way round for every small step of the hour hand. The outer loop counts the rows, from one to four. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Nested loops and patterns in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: The outer loop gives the row r.
shorts.script: The outer loop gives the row r. The inner loop gives the column c. Each cell shows r times c. In row two, the cells are two, four and six. The line break ends each row. The program prints a grid with three rows. The last row shows three, six and nine. A nested loop is a loop inside a loop. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A missing line break
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in nested loops and patterns?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in nested loops and patterns? Bug of the Day. We want a triangle. The program prints ten stars in one long line. The line break is after both loops. It runs only once. Move endl inside the outer loop, after the inner loop. Then each row gets its own line. The line break sits after both loops, so all ten stars go on one line. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A missing line break.

shorts.script: Can you print a number triangle in nested loops and patterns? I printed a triangle of stars. It was a very sharp piece of code. Print a triangle of numbers.
